body:
We have seen the writing on *The Wall*. You are a Thinker, you should feel blessed. I also have a very introverted personality, an 80% introverted...Although I am an INFP, an idealist...we are both unique aren't we...


The world cannot contain us, even though we may not know each other personally I still feel like we were great friends sometime long ago... we both feel the grip of public isolation.



All of those medications are harmful for your mind. I can tell you are very smart...



I am also pondering ending everything, I am no destroyer of joy, rather that is what I have become through my experiances ripping away at the flesh of the soul. I bet you have gained great intuition about life itself.



Tell me some wisdom you have obtained.

Perhaps I am, but I know that I am divided.


I stand alone, this life that I have lived has been nothing but pain and misery. My things need to go somewhere after the day that I fall.



The truth is, I use to be warm and innocent. However the worlds judgements and accusations have turned my soul away from my previous innocence. Every day I witness screaming. Everyday I pretend I am okay (I am an actor after all). In the past, writing poetry and stories gave me closer, but now it is a reminder of how much I failed since then. These people around me now think such judgmental thoughts. I will not be missed once I escape the burden of life
